name: agentmemory
description: Gives coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Gemini CLI a shared local memory server that captures sessions through hooks and serves recall over MCP and REST.

skills.name: Automatic Hook Capture
skills.description: Records observations from agent sessions through native plugins and lifecycle hooks, so memory builds without manual saves.

skills.name: Triple-Stream Retrieval
skills.description: Recalls memories by fusing BM25, vector, and knowledge-graph results with reciprocal rank fusion; keyless mode falls back to BM25.

skills.name: Tiered Memory Consolidation
skills.description: Consolidates memories across four tiers, decays stale ones over time, strengthens frequently used ones, and resolves contradictions.

skills.name: Memory Git Snapshots
skills.description: Versions memory state with git snapshots so you can diff it, roll it back, or restore an earlier version.

skills.name: Team Memory
skills.description: Shares namespaced memory across team members while keeping private memories separate for each person.
